Does not redisclose plaintext. Repeating create/rotate/revoke with existing operationId is 409 OPERATION_REUSED, not success replay.
readBack.absence: Inventory absence cannot prove no commit if session/role/workspace changed, snapshot failed, or principal/key not visible. Missing operation history -> 400, not an explicit HTTP not-found outcome receipt. If original omitted operationId and receipt was lost, generated operationId is lost; list has no operation IDs or secrets and no name-based safe dedup. Manual authoritative reconciliation/cancel or explicit new operation after resolution required.
readBack.oneTime: Unknown create/rotate: do not silently generate new key or replay. Recover completed only returns IDs; lost secret cannot be retrieved. Use known principal+credential with explicit fresh rotation and new operationId after reconciliation, revoke unusable exposed/unknown credential as needed. Rotation atomically disables old key on known commit; old key must not be assumed usable after unknown result.
readBack.nativeTools: Explicit recover_service_principal with same retained operationId, exact body and outer+inner confirm:true. service_principals only returns metadata/credential IDs, never secret or operation IDs. No reconcile alias. Read current me/companies for context, not write outcome.

retry.unresolvedProvider: No external provider call in current native execution: key generation, SHA-256 lookup hash, apikey rows, lifecycle events and operation history are one control transaction. Unknown commit remains unknown until reconciliation. Legacy pending/failed/recovering histories require native recovery, never infer disabled from provider failed state.

input.notes: Advertised confirm:true is stronger than deserialization bool: false reaches SDK invalid_input. Body is a string, never an embedded JSON object. Empty/Write deny unknown tool argument fields; request/params ignore unknown fields. No local body-file interpretation. Actual derived Write also accepts exact positional [bodyString,boolean]; wrong sequence length/types refuse; false confirmation still reaches SDK invalid_input.

success.invariants: HTTP2xx parsed JSON returned as data without response-shape validation. structuredContent.ok=data.ok only when boolean, otherwise true; isError=(ok==false). content[0].text is exact compact JSON of structuredContent. Native producers here emit ok:true. HTTP status is not an MCP field; no per-tool process exit.

refusal.semantics: Non2xx bodies are discarded, never exposed as native HTTP error envelopes. GET any non2xx -> server_refused with status. POST5xx -> outcome_unknown; other non2xx -> server_refused. Valid2xx JSON ok:false is data with isError:true, not error details. No idempotencyKey in these selected tool errors.

variants.when: Identity router installed but service_lifecycle handler absent; before all gates.
Query present; duplicate/overlong Cookie header; malformed/invalid body or NotCommitted invalid_request.
Invalid origin/host/fetch-site, no observed peer; Unix peer mismatch if local transport middleware installed.
Authorization or x-rentemester-service-key header present (presence alone; human-only gate).

Missing/invalid signed profile cookie, no optional session, or NotCommitted invalid_credentials: expired/not fresh/current, disabled/non-owner, unverified email/MFA or session/factor authorization refusal.
Media/encoding refusal.
Shared lifecycle peer budget or rate-map capacity/lock refusal.
Four-slot capacity semaphore unavailable.
to_bytes failed.
Body timeout.
NotCommitted operation_reused: caller operationId already in history; no redisclosure.

All other native failures, poisoned owner/unavailable admission, unknown commit, task panic/join failure or invalid receipt status. This includes fence, storage integrity/bounds/clock failure, not a business-success envelope.
Installed outer protocol layer refuses partial/duplicate/stale/unsupported negotiation before dispatch.

parseProtocol.transport: 1MiB UTF8 newline-delimited frames for all selected tools. Invalid JSON or missing final newline -> -32700 id:null. Oversized -> error response then stderr message limit exceeded and process exit1. Ordinary request errors do not exit. EOF exit0. Config/local credential file/runtime setup failures are stderr only: config exit2, serve failure exit1; no JSON-RPC tool result or stdout banner.
parseProtocol.session: Initialize then notifications/initialized. Notifications never execute tools or respond. IDs string<=256 UTF8 bytes or signed64/unsigned64 integer; no null/fraction. IDs cannot repeat, retained maximum100000; sequential tool execution. Extra request/params properties ignored; params must object; task presence refused. Unknown method -32601; tool dispatch/parser error -32602.
parseProtocol.sdk: Per-send bare /api/protocol preflight errors map protocol before dependent dispatch, never retry. Sends origin + protocol1/current manifest/rust-http-v1, cookie OR service-key. No redirects/proxy inheritance; connect10s/total30s. Post-dispatch send/read errors -> outcome_unknown on writes, transport on reads. JSON success >16MiB or invalid JSON -> outcome_unknown on writes, protocol on reads. Response media-type is not validated by request().
parseProtocol.argumentParsing: serde_json::from_value on derived struct accepts map or exact positional sequence: Empty {}|[]; Write {body:string,confirm:boolean}|[string,boolean]. Unknown map fields, wrong sequence length/types, null and scalars map to -32602. Parsed false confirmation reaches SDK invalid_input. Advertised tools/list schemas remain object-only.

negotiation.unversioned: All three headers absent accepted during major 1; does not bypass authentication.
negotiation.duplicates: Each negotiation header exactly one; method/path must occur in installed manifest; mismatch 409 before dispatch. No wire envelope normalization between profiles.

upstreamNegotiation.query: Any query present, even empty ?, is refused 400 by gates before admission; no filtering or duplicate query semantics because all queries rejected.
upstreamNegotiation.body: POST: first non-ASCII-whitespace byte must be {; strict serde Wire, unknown fields/duplicate recognized fields, absent required fields, wrong type and null refused 400. Valid optional string is absent or string, not null. Content length is not relied upon: 8192-byte actual body cap, 2s to_bytes timeout. GET consumes same bounded body and requires zero bytes (whitespace also 400).
upstreamNegotiation.contentType: POST requires single application/json case-insensitive, parameters only charset=utf-8 (repeat allowed); any content-encoding header refused 415. GET does not require content-type but rejects any content-encoding.

variants.when: Query, malformed JSON, invalid action combination, missing/invalid confirm or UUID or expiry, invalid storage request.
to_bytes error (including oversized body).
Body read exceeds two seconds.
Unsupported content-type or any content-encoding.
Installed outer protocol layer refuses partial/duplicate/stale/unsupported negotiation before dispatch.

binary.secret: Create/rotate one-time secret occurs in BOTH structuredContent.data and serialized content text; protect whole receipt. No private examples or local files.

paginationFilterOrder.query: All query presence rejected for GET/POST. HEAD ignores query.
paginationFilterOrder.order: GET principals ORDER BY created_at,user_id COLLATE BINARY; each credentials ORDER BY id COLLATE BINARY. No filter/cursor/offset. LIMIT 1001 detects >1000 principals; at most 1000 credentials total across principals. Overflow/integrity failure is AUTH_UNCONFIRMED 503, not truncation. Receipt serialized <=1048576 bytes. Not applicable to action receipts/HEAD.
paginationFilterOrder.activeCount: enabled NULL counts active; expiry does not reduce count. No promise this count represents effective grants/valid credentials.

native.confirmation: POST confirm must be boolean true, including recover. GET no confirmation. HEAD executes no action.
native.revision: No revision token, If-Match or optimistic version input; headers do not implement a revision check. Immediate control writer transaction provides serialization.
native.currentAuthority: Human-only profile-bound signed cookie, matching workspace and verifier key; current unexpired native session. GET Current; all POST including Recover Fresh (age strictly <600000ms). Session max lifetime 43200000ms. Native current user exists, email verified, MFA enabled, exactly one verified factor, current session and latest workspace role workspace_owner; rechecked in same writer transaction.
native.originCsrf: Host exactly configured authority as a single header. POST Origin required exactly configured origin; GET Origin may be absent but if present must exactly match. sec-fetch-site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate headers fail one(). No separate CSRF token input. No service-key/Bearer fallback.
native.rate: GET and all four POST map to same ServiceLifecycle rate key: 10 per 60s per canonical peer. Timestamp advances on admitted attempts (cooldown), IPv4-mapped normalized; IPv6 /64 grouped; local verified Unix uid if used. Map cap 4096, mutex failure denies, retry-after:60. Auth parsed after rate and before semaphore/body. Four shared workers, permit held through blocking work even after HTTP disconnect.
native.pipeline: Host lifetime/workspace admission -> application connection fence -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> non-List workspace transfer require_business_write active -> cookie_session resolve Current/Fresh -> authorize + owner role -> checked inventory/history/action -> prepared bounded receipt -> commit (List rollback). No grants supplied here; company grants/permissions are separate, and credential issuance alone is not company authorization.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.nativeAuthority: These annotations are hints, not authorization. No revision token, client actor, credentials or company grants in arguments. Lifecycle requires current verified MFA human workspace_owner, fresh session for every mutation including recover; service-key-configured process receives server refusal, no fallback. me/companies accept current human OR scoped service credential.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Explicit outer true AND exact inner confirm:true for lifecycle writes, including recover.

key.meaning: No generic retry key or replay guarantee. operationId is lifecycle correlation/collision refusal only; JSON-RPC id is session request correlation and reuse is refused.

retry.naturalDedup: Not applicable: display names are not unique identity; operationId history prevents reuse but refuses replay rather than replaying receipt. Revoke of an already disabled extant key with a new ID can append another operation.
